verdict.rationale: Fathom's own marketing says users can choose bot-free or bot capture ('bot or no bot', 'Now available bot-free'), which addresses the core of the story. However, the bot-free mode is labeled beta, and the evidence never explains how it works or confirms that external participants see nothing. missing for 10: documentation that audio is captured on-device, confirmation that the capture is invisible to other participants, a non-beta (GA) bot-free mode, platform/meeting-app coverage details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
